Resolves #21303

`project()` now leaves a pass when `owner.getLayoutRect(ids)` answers anything other than a list (a server-side render's stand-in answers one object). It applies no split and logs nothing. The leave is a `break pass` on the labeled `try`, not a `return`, so the `finally` still releases `measuring` and the drain below it still runs and fires `overflowProjectionIdle`. A `return` would skip that drain and leave `whenProjectionIdle()` waiting. Both measures are guarded. The strip measure is guarded after the withheld-action reveal is switched off again. No public behavior changes in a browser, where the answer is always a list.

Evidence: L2 (unit spec, failing on `dev` without the fix) -> L2 required (AC-1..AC-3); AC-4 is the maintainer's post-release site build.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Proof |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `Overflow.spec.mjs` "a measure without layout ... skips the pass quietly": no `console.error`, `measuring` false, last event `overflowProjectionIdle`, no button `hidden`, no control |
| AC-2 | Same test, built on `createPlugin(async ids => { ...; return {} })`. On `dev` it fails with 3 × `Neo.tab.plugin.Overflow: project() threw against a live owner` / `TypeError: rects.shift is not a function` |
| AC-3 | `npx playwright test -c test/playwright/playwright.config.unit.mjs test/playwright/unit/tab/plugin/Overflow.spec.mjs` → 78 passed (76 passed + 2 failed with the fix reverted) |
| AC-4 | Post-merge, maintainer (site build log) |

## Deltas from ticket
- A second test covers the reveal ordering the ticket asks for. The natural-width measure answers a list and the strip measure answers `{}`. `setContextualActionMeasureReveal` must be called `[true, false]`, and `measuringWithheldActions` must end `false`.

## Test Evidence
- `test/playwright/unit/tab` → 165 passed.
- `check-parse`, `check-shorthand`, `check-whitespace`, `check-file-sizes`, `check-class-module-scope`, `check-engine-brain-boundary` clean; `check-block-alignment` reports only the pre-existing drift at `Overflow.spec.mjs:98-100`.

## Post-Merge Validation
- [ ] AC-4: the first site build on a release with this fix logs no `project() threw against a live owner` line.

## Comments

### `@bardrop` commented on 2026-11-18T11:15:38Z

Thanks, good catch on both. Fixed in a2ad16e:

- `measure.length > 0` is now `measure.every(ids => ids[0] === 'b1')`, so it checks that every pass leaves at the natural-width measure.
- `plugin.control === null` is gone. The `syncControl` stub now records its calls and the test expects none, since `applySplit` always ends there.

I checked it the same way you did: with the guard at `Overflow.mjs:991` removed, this test now fails ("every pass leaves at the natural-width measure") and the other 77 pass. With the guard in place, all 78 pass.

**Verdict:** Request Changes

**Glance:** #21303 asks `project()` to leave a pass when `getLayoutRect` answers something other than a list, after the measure reveal is switched off. At `19132bb` both measures do that (`Overflow.mjs:991` and `:1034`, the second after the reveal block), and the diff touches no other site. A `return` there would skip the drain at `:1176`, so `whenProjectionIdle()` would never resolve; `break pass` is the first labeled jump in `src/`, and the comment above it gives the reason. I ran the spec at this head: 78 passed. With `dev`'s `Overflow.mjs`, your two new tests fail and the other 76 pass. I looked for a pass that leaves restored buttons on screen: the first measure can follow the restore of withheld or capped buttons (`:967`–`:985`), but where there is no layout no split is ever applied, so nothing is withheld to restore.

**Findings:**

- [ ] Two assertions in the first new test cannot fail. `measure.length > 0` ("both measures ran", `Overflow.spec.mjs:251`): with your fix every pass leaves at the natural-width measure, since `naturalWidths` is never written, and with the guard at `Overflow.mjs:991` deleted all 78 tests still pass (I ran it). `expect(measure.every(ids => ids[0] === 'b1')).toBe(true)` holds at this head and fails without that guard. `plugin.control` is `null` (`:255`) with or without the fix: `createPlugin` sets it, and the test stubs `syncControl` (`:241`), the only path that creates a control afterwards. Count the stub's calls and expect zero instead; `applySplit` always ends in `syncControl` (`Overflow.mjs:1343`), so that checks the ticket's "apply no split".
